tagline: Engineering and construction services provider serving power generation, industrial, and teledata markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The project backlog is a key indicator of financial health and future growth, particularly in the construction and engineering sector where it reflects confirmed demand and revenue visibility.

kpis.name: Consolidated Project Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of projects currently under execution with defined scope and estimable contract value
kpis.description: The consolidated project backlog represents expected revenues from remaining work on projects where the scope is sufficiently defined

kpis.name: Industrial Segment Project Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of projects currently under execution in the industrial segment
kpis.description: The industrial segment is experiencing rapid expansion with contracts in automotive, data centers, and other industries
kpis.signal: Major growth in the industrial segment with new automotive and data center contracts

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per share to shareholders
kpis.description: Dividend per share is a source of regular income for shareholders, maintained at a stable level
kpis.signal: Stable dividend demonstrating a consistent capital return policy

kpis.name: Fiscal 2025 Project Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of projects currently under execution as of January 31, 2025
kpis.description: The fiscal 2025 project backlog represents the baseline before the 107% increase in fiscal 2026
kpis.signal: Baseline project backlog before significant fiscal 2026 growth

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2022-2026) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Fraud and financial loss
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors (Item 1A), the language is direct regarding a complex fraud and a net loss of $2.7M after recovery. Although funds were recovered, the risk of fraud remains a major concern for financial security.

risks.title: International contract dispute
risks.score_rationale: Described in detail in Item 7, this dispute involves a UK subsidiary with an estimated loss of $13.4M recorded progressively ($3.4M in fiscal 2025, remainder in fiscal 2024). Unresolved billable claims, contract variations, and claims indicate significant complexity.

risks.title: Dependence on the energy market
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 details that the project backlog is largely composed of Power segment projects. A high concentration in the energy sector may amplify sector-specific risks related to regulatory and financing cycles.

risks.title: Project delay risk
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 explicitly states that project start-ups are controlled by owners and delays may occur. A specific example is given for the Midwest solar project, which experienced regulatory delays.

risks.title: Contract loss management
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 mentions a $13.4M contract loss on a foreign project, recorded progressively. This indicates an ongoing risk of poor estimation or cost overruns on complex international contracts.

risks.title: Volatility in the electricity market and interconnection delays
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 details challenges in the energy market: equipment supply constraints, interconnection delays, regulatory changes, and financing considerations. These factors can impact project development timelines and viability.

ai_positioning.summary: AGX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. The company focuses on engineering and construction of energy infrastructure.
